---
name: campus-grading-rules
description: The university's grading rules (weights, rounding, pass marks). Use when the user asks how a final grade is computed or what is needed to pass.
---
1. Final grade = the sum of grade × weight over all items, divided by 100, rounded to 2 decimals.
2. A course is passed when the final grade is at least 5 and the exam grade is at least 5.
3. A grade someone still needs is rounded **up** (needing 7.241 means needing 7.25).
